v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Dómine, * osténde nobis Patrem, et súfficit nobis, allelúia.
text.en: Lord, show us the Father, * and it sufficeth us. Alleluia.

text.la: Philíppe, * qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúia.
text.en: Philip, * He that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

text.la: Tanto témpore * vobíscum sum, et non cognovístis me? Philíppe, qui videt me, videt et Patrem meum, allelúia.
text.en: Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known Me * Philip, he that hath seen Me hath seen the Father. Alleluia.

text.la: Si cognovissétis me, * et Patrem meum útique cognovissétis, et ámodo cognoscétis eum, et vidístis eum, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: If ye had known Me ye should have known My Father also, * and from henceforth ye know Him and have seen Him. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Si dilígitis me, * mandáta mea serváte, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: If ye love Me, * keep My commandments. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Stabunt iusti in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
text.en: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Si manséritis in me, * et verba mea in vobis mánserint, quodcúmque petiéritis, fiet vobis, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: If ye abide in Me * and My words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui nos ánnua Apostolórum tuórum Philíppi et Iacóbi solemnitáte lætíficas: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quorum gaudémus méritis, instruámur exémplis.
text.en: O God, Who dost every year gladden us by the solemn memorial of thine Apostles Philip and James, grant us grace, we beseech thee, not only to rejoice because of their worthy deeds, but also to tread in their footsteps.
